meta.title: Operating Scorecard
meta.note: Sample finance-ops metrics only. Replace values from the linked tracker Pages.

metrics.name: Overdue AR
metrics.nextAction: Work the 90+ aging bucket; call the five largest past-due customers.
metrics.escalationTrigger: Overdue AR exceeds $50,000 for two consecutive weeks.

metrics.name: Invoice count
metrics.nextAction: Keep current collections cadence; close remaining current-bucket invoices before month-end.
metrics.escalationTrigger: Open invoice count exceeds 100 or grows two weeks in a row.

metrics.name: Forecast accuracy
metrics.nextAction: Revisit demand drivers for the last three miss months; publish a bias note with the next forecast.
metrics.escalationTrigger: MAPE stays above 12% for two consecutive months.

metrics.name: Billing cycle time
metrics.nextAction: Clear the sent→approved queue; add a same-week follow-up on invoices older than 10 days.
metrics.escalationTrigger: Median quote→paid exceeds 20 days in any week.

metrics.name: Payment control adoption
metrics.nextAction: Close vendor bank-account verification exceptions; coach the two lagging control owners.
metrics.escalationTrigger: Average adoption falls below 90% or any named control drops month-over-month.

metrics.name: 13-week cash minimum
metrics.nextAction: Pull collections forward into weeks 8–9; defer non-critical vendor payments across the trough.
metrics.escalationTrigger: Any week below $25,000, or two consecutive weeks below the $50,000 threshold.
